question: What is the meaning of ratings or certificates in general in relation to official (mandated) indicators and certificates?
description: Ratings or certificates generally indicate the level of compliance or performance of a building or project against established standards or criteria. These assessments are often linked to official (mandated) indicators and certificates, serving as a form of third-party verification to ensure quality, sustainability, or other specific attributes are met. They facilitate objective comparisons and can be used as marketing tools to demonstrate adherence to recognized benchmarks.
